newsitem.title: USA: Universal Int'l same-store sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Universal Int'l same-store sales fall.

text.p: Universal International Inc said on Monday that same-store sales at its Only Deals and Odd's-N-End's retail stores fell 14.2 percent during September.

"We are addressing the merchandising issues which have contributed to the weaker-than-expected sales in the third quarter with our new general merchandise manager and feel that we have identified opportunities for improvement which will enable us to reverse the recent negative comparable store sales trend over the next several months," said Mark Ravich, chief executive.
Comparable-store sales are based sales of stores open more than 14 full months, the company said.

Universal, which buys and sells "close-out" merchandise at its wholesale and retail businesses, said total sales at Only Deals and Odd's-N-End's rose 15.4 percent to $4,236,000 in September from $3,670,000 a year ago.
Sales for the nine months ended September 30 rose 28.1 percent to $35,386,000 versus $27,635,000 during the same period last year, the company said.
